_doc: Source audit for lesson_7-9_islamic_parenting_worship_06 (held in ../review-2026-10-07/lesson-source-audit.json). Agent audit 2026-10-07 against the live KB and the project's hadith corpus (ops/data/hadith_index.json.gz). Not a scholar's review.
search: All Arabic KB units (knowledge_base/units/*.json) scanned for wudu vocabulary (وضوء/توضأ/المضمضة/الاستنشاق/المرفقين/الكعبين/المرافق/فاغسلوا وجوهكم/كفيه ثلاث) and for citations of Bukhari 159, Muslim 226 or al-Ma'ida 5:6. One unit describes wudu steps: isl-3f0af447. Two others matched only incidentally (968f42b5…: garbled Tarbiyat al-Tifl extraction about Qur'an recitation; isl-8e3e1052: anger). No unit quotes Bukhari 159 / Muslim 226 or Qur'an 5:6.

units.isl-3f0af447: verified live unit — Alukah «حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين» pp.99–102, refilled from the OCR'd pages on 2026-10-05 (kb_fidelity/gaps.md item 1) and corrected after an independent page-image review (PR #41, 9bcac491: non-Sahihayn narrations turned into reported speech). Age 7-9. Already the source of the prayer journey's wudu stage. Content: al-Bara' ibn 'Azib gathered his family and showed them the Prophet's ﷺ wudu: rinsing the mouth and nose, the face ×3, the right then the left arm ×3, wiping the head and both sides of the ears, the right then the left foot ×3 (Ahmad, graded hasan by the author — described, not quoted as Sahihayn).
units.isl-c4d83813: authored guidance on teaching prayer (PR #27) — kept as in the Arabic
units.isl-ab49af82: withdrawn as unfaithful (Alukah p.144 is about sleep after Fajr and circumcision) — removed from the English unit_ids

claims_vs_sources.wash the palms first; arms 'to the elbow: not in a KB unit; the project corpus holds it in Sahih al-Bukhari 159 / Sahih Muslim 226 (ʿUthmān's wudu: «فأفرغ على كفيه ثلاث مرار … ويديه إلى المرفقين … رجليه … إلى الكعبين»). The lesson states these as steps, quoting nothing.
claims_vs_sources.intention in the heart: general principle (Sahih al-Bukhari 1, «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»); stated as a step, not quoted
claims_vs_sources.saying Bismillah: no Sahihayn text on tasmiyah for wudu and no KB unit; stated as a step without attribution (a sunnah per most scholars, obligatory per the Hanbalis). Flagged for Khaled, not a blocker: nothing is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ
claims_vs_sources.detailed fiqh questions (what breaks wud: the lesson defers to a trusted fiqh book or scholar

source_verdict: verified for the washed and wiped members and their order (isl-3f0af447); the remaining steps are standard practice stated without attribution and agree with Bukhari 159 / Muslim 226 in the corpus. No hadith text fabricated, no KB unit created.
decision: restored from ops/data/en_unpublished; English unit_ids now equal the Arabic's; stamped by both families (no defect)
